request.style: English, female solo voice, warm and intimate, acoustic guitar, piano, soft cello, gentle drums, hopeful and protective mood, 72 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
The sun will not strike you by day
Nor the moon by night
The Lord is your shade at your right side
Protecting your sight

[Chorus]
The Lord will keep you from all harm
He will watch over your life
The Lord will watch over your going out
And your coming in
Now and forevermore

[Verse]
He who watches over Israel
Neither slumbers nor sleeps
He sees every step of your life
While you quietly weeps

[Chorus]
The Lord will keep you from all harm
He will watch over your life
The Lord will watch over your going out
And your coming in
Now and forevermore

[Bridge]
From the morning light to the dark
He is near to your heart
No shadow of harm can remain
When his watch is the same

[Chorus]
The Lord will keep you from all harm
He will watch over your life
The Lord will watch over your going out
And your coming in
Now and forevermore

[Outro]
Now and forevermore
He watches over you
